measurement_notes: Inference counts and tokens come from unique completed response_id records for this task; final summary overhead after cutoff is excluded.
Cached input tokens are included in input_tokens; reasoning output tokens are included in output_tokens.
Nested tool calls are counted from orchestration source. Outer exec calls are reported separately to avoid double counting.
LOC is physical added lines, including comments and blanks. Debug is retained diagnostic scripts/recipes, not cumulative edit churn. Generated logs, media, README, and this metrics JSON are excluded.
The pre-existing user change to the author-environment skill is excluded.
